name: Swallow Avatar
author: zhou-jianwen
variant_note: Independent plush-bird interpretation of the actual swallow photograph supplied in request #101, preserving the requested indigo, white and coral palette, attached feather crest and forked tail. The request mentions a personal avatar but includes no human portrait; no human likeness is inferred or claimed.
license: CC BY-NC 4.0 for the independently generated pet artwork. Non-commercial use only; commercial use is prohibited. No rights to the requester-supplied photograph are claimed.
description: A cheerful rounded plush swallow bird in deep indigo, snowy white and coral, with a tiny attached crest and a connected forked tail, for nine task states and sixteen clockwise look directions.
asset_note: The final sprite artwork is independently AI-generated with OpenAI image generation, directed and quality-checked in Codex. The supplied photograph is appearance reference only; its pixels, perch, background and watermark are not reused.
reference_note: The no-account requester supplied a swallow photograph rather than a human portrait. The photographer, bird owner and source-image license are unidentified; a visible account watermark is not treated as proof of authorship. This package implements the supplied bird reference and stated visual motifs. Any required human-portrait component remains outside the available reference evidence.
